title: Throughput entitlement onboarding and provisioning orchestration for Dedicated Fleet
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Define and implement an entitlement-driven provisioning flow that lets customers request, justify, and obtain committed throughput on Dedicated fleets with measurable onboarding SLAs and automated autoscaling guardrails.

Background: Customers frequently ask for predictable per-tenant throughput guarantees that integrate with our Dedicated reservation system. Current intake flows are manual, ad-hoc, and require operations intervention for capacity validation and quota adjustments. This initiative builds a formalized entitlement model (requested throughput, business justification, required SLA), a programmable approval workflow, and policy-driven autoscale knobs so that provisioning can be partially automated while preserving fleet stability.

Out of scope: pricing contract negotiation, long-term billing reconciliation (handled by Finance), and on-prem air-gapped installs (follow-up work).
acceptance_criteria: A documented entitlement model that captures requested throughput (tokens/sec or rps), target latency SLO, expected peak window, and business justification
A request form/template embedded in Console + an API endpoint to create entitlement requests
An approval policy engine that can auto-approve low-risk requests and route medium/high-risk requests to capacity operations
Autoscale policy presets (conservative, balanced, aggressive) that map to fleet-level controls and emergency fallback capacity
End-to-end test demonstrating a provisioning request from submission to capacity reservation with telemetry visible in Console (request, approval status, allocated GPUs, and applied autoscale preset)
Rollout plan and runbook for ops to revert or adjust entitlements during unexpected load spikes
tasks: Draft entitlement schema and example templates
Design Console intake UX and API contract
Build approval policy engine prototype (rule-based) and integrate with notification hooks
Implement autoscale preset mapping and expose controls in fleet config
Create end-to-end integration test harness with synthetic load and telemetry checks
Prepare rollout runbook and customer communication templates
